problem.name: Group commutativity
problem.statement_latex: Given $k$ generators of a black-box group, decide whether the generated subgroup is abelian, equivalently whether every pair of generators commutes. Complexity counts group-operation oracle calls.
problem.statement_text: Given $k$ generators of a black-box group, decide whether the generated subgroup is abelian, equivalently whether every pair of generators commutes. Complexity counts group-operation oracle calls.
